item.name: Waterproof Standing Toiletry Bag Foldable Clear Hanging Travel Cosmetic Bag Large Capacity Organizer
item.title: Waterproof Standing Toiletry Bag Foldable Clear Hanging Travel Cosmetic Bag Large Capacity Organizer
item.description:
Looking for a practical toiletry bag that keeps all your travel essentials neatly arranged? 🧳 This waterproof hanging clear toiletry organizer is exactly what you need for your trips, gym sessions, camping, daily bathroom use and school dorm!

Made of high-quality thick waterproof PVC material 💧, it is splash-resistant and super easy to clean. Just wipe it with a damp cloth when it gets dirty, no troublesome washing needed. The transparent design allows you to see all your cosmetics, skincare, shampoo, toothbrush and makeup supplies at a glance, so you can grab what you want quickly without rummaging around.

Comes with a sturdy hanging hook 🪝, you can hang it on shower rods, bathroom doors, towel racks, perfect for hotel bathrooms with limited counter space. It stands steadily on flat surfaces too! Multiple separate pockets and large main compartment give you generous storage space, sorting small items and big bottles separately to avoid mess.

Lightweight & foldable design 📌. When you don’t use it, simply fold it flat, it will not occupy extra space in your luggage or backpack. Equipped with smooth durable zipper and comfortable carry handle, it is not easy to break and very convenient to carry around.

Great for travel, business trip, gym, swimming, overnight stay and daily home storage. Available in classic Black and Gray 🖤🤍, simple and stylish, suitable for men and women. Say goodbye to messy toiletries and enjoy tidy travel!
